name: option-test-1b0c555df9/option_with_boolean-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
reason: The record type, included record parameter and member access are supported, but the asserted result depends on the executable entry-point argument binder interpreting the bare command-line option --bool as true in the included record. Command-line option binding and boolean flag semantics are not covered by subset10's supported features; signature support alone does not establish this behavior.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line boolean flag --bool binding to an included-record main parameter
test_design_notes: The @args annotation and expected true output assert command-line binding behavior. io:println is output instrumentation only.
